name: uwujacker
description: CLI para descargar episodios de anime desde JKAnime con soporte de slugs y descargas paralelas

scripts.build:exe: npx esbuild index.js --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --outfile=dist/bundle.js && node --experimental-sea-config sea-config.json && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const path=require('node:path'); const target = process.platform === 'win32' ? 'uwujacker.exe' : 'uwujacker'; fs.mkdirSync('dist', { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync(process.execPath, path.join('dist', target)); const { execSync } = require('node:child_process'); execSync('npx postject@latest ' + JSON.stringify(path.join('dist', target)) + ' NODE_SEA_BLOB dist/sea-prep.blob --sentinel-fuse NODE_SEA_FUSE_fce680ab2cc467b6e072b8b5df1996b2', { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
